messages:
maya: FYI seeing apiserver 503 bursts in ap-south around 13:47 UTC. Scheduler shows GPU pods stuck Pending; controller-manager logs show repeated leader renew failures.

alert-bot: [ALERT] apiserver_5xx_rate spike (ap-south) and etcd_disk_fsync p99=1.9s

eden: Any infra changes? network?

pablo: We rolled a CNI patch last night that adjusted host MTU (changed from 9000->8950) for fragmentation tuning. Some nodes started flapping keepalives with the controlplane. Packet captures show TCP MSS mismatch causing retransmits.

maya: Controller-manager excerpt:

```
E0325 13:47:11.556 leaderelection.go:243] failed to renew lease: timed out waiting for the condition
I0325 13:47:11.557 controller_manager.go:130] leader lost due to etcd timeout
```

maya: Meanwhile etcd p99 WAL fsync ~1.9s and apiserver request latencies climb. Controller-manager keeps cycling leadership and reconciliation stalls so GPU node claims don't progress.

en: Scheduler backlog: 50 pending gpu-onboard pods, many with predicate NoVolumeZoneConflict and NoNodesAvailable.

pablo: So root causes: MTU tweak created intermittent packet fragmentation between subset of worker nodes and controlplane VMs leading to retransmits -> increased RPC latency to etcd WAL -> leader renew timeouts.

eden: Immediate mitigations proposed:
- revert CNI MTU change for the affected ASG (fast rollback)
- cordon/controlplane-pod-move off hosts with highest retransmit rates
- temporarily increase controller-manager leaseDuration to 55s (staging first)

maya: I rolled back the CNI MTU on the 3 affected subnets at 13:53 UTC, started draining a noisy worker node, and restarted controller-manager pods. By 13:58 the leader stabilized and reconciliations resumed. Most pending GPU pods started scheduling.

pablo: Cost impact: during the 11m outage we had ~95k tokens routed to hosted fallback; rough incremental cost $270. Need to include in infra-costs.

en: Longer term actions:
- add a preflight for MTU changes that runs a small keepalive / MSS compatibility test to controlplane IPs
- alert rule: etcd WAL fsync p99 > 1s for 3m -> page oncall
- add controller-manager metric for consecutive lease renew failures to trigger automated rollback of nonessential CNI changes

maya: I'll put together a short runbook section: "MTU-induced keepalive retransmits -> etcd fsync tail latency -> controller lease flaps" with detection commands and rollback steps. Assignments:
- maya: runbook + incident timeline
- pablo: PR for MTU preflight test and CNI change gating
- eden: alert rule + grafana dash for renew-failures

alert-bot: incident-created: INC-20260325-88 (severity: low->medium). Runbook draft: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/mtu-etcd-leases

maya: Follow-up planned: test leaseDuration bump in staging next Tue, and include SLAs for GPU provisioning fallback costs. Will update when done. Thanks :wave:
